texts.name: Kharjul
texts.biography: In forgotten lands, where even death fears to linger too long, lived a gnoll named Kharjul. He was the leader of a pack—cruel, merciless, and insatiable. His name was whispered with terror even among other gnolls. But one day, he encountered not prey… but a predator stronger than himself.

specialty.description: Receives a 5% per level bonus to Vampirism skill percentage.
specialty.name: Vampirism
